newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline leaps $17, other products inspired.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline leaps $17, other products inspired.

text.p: NWE oil products were inspired by firmer gasoline on Monday
Gasoline values jumped $17 on the first half August Eurograde barge market to trade at $232. There were rumours of a prompt to mid-August cargo doneat $232 CIF NWE.
Gas oil was steady to firmer on IPE futures closing 75 cents up. Heating barges were around +$1.00 with Antwerp at +50 cents.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose to $94/$95 on a shortage of prompt avails. Cargoes were assessed at about $89/$90.
One percent cargoes were firmer with a trade reported at $95.25 fob after an earlier deal at $92.50.
